question: After generic Shatter, threshold, same-enemy repeat, heavy-Attack relay, Facet-state and global Art families are closed, does exact current-main expose one untested per-card Shatter target topology?
scientificBasis: Within a PLAY-to-card-terminal event window, SHATTER events have an enemy idx. Event count and distinct idx count produce an exhaustive four-cell topology: none; one event on one target; multiple events on one target; or multiple events across multiple targets. Exact prior evidence closes the first three as non-events, ordinary Shatter or same-enemy repeat families. The last cell is a distinct cross-enemy concurrency relation and exact content supplies five all-enemy damage-or-chip cards plus 22 multi-enemy formations.

frontierScope.included: The count of SHATTER events and distinct enemy idx values emitted while one played card resolves. The representation is Dusk-only by existing apply_chips law and adds no payoff, state, event, threshold or carrier.
excluded: Art or potion Shatters outside a PLAY window
same-enemy Shatter threshold or reseam reward
hit count, damage, Ward, status or partial-Facet threshold
card, enemy, act or formation subset
payoff, carrier, acquisition or policy score
new persistent state, ML, RL or optimiser
frontierScope.claimBoundary: This source-only audit may select at most one topology for a separately preregistered zero-new-row capacity screen. It cannot establish natural activation, candidate payoff, causal effect, complementarity, acquisition, package acceptance or product authority.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains zero SHATTER events and therefore zero distinct Shatter targets.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: No Shatter topology exists; rewarding this cell would be an Attack, card-play or failure scalar.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains exactly one SHATTER event on one enemy idx.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: This is ordinary target-local Shatter. Its threshold, global payoff, Art buff and temporal fuel variants are bounded closed families.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains at least two SHATTER events but exactly one distinct enemy idx.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: Repeated same-enemy Shatter is the closed reseam topology; selecting hit multiplicity or a card subset would reopen frozen families.

cardShatterTopologyPartition.definition: The PLAY window contains at least two SHATTER events on at least two distinct living-enemy idx values.
cardShatterTopologyPartition.reason: This is a resolved card-scoped cross-enemy concurrency relation. It is not the closed pre-card partial-Facet ownership predicate, same-target repeat, global Art buff or hit-multiplicity scalar.

selectedRepresentation.name: multi-enemy card Shatter
selectedRepresentation.exactPredicate: Within one PLAY-to-card-terminal event window, SHATTER event count is at least two and the set of SHATTER idx values has size at least two.
selectedRepresentation.eventOrderSafety: The window begins at PLAY and ends at the played card's TO_DISCARD, EXHAUST or POWER_CONSUMED event. Art and turn-boundary Shatters are outside it.

capacityEvidenceBoundary.eligibleCache: Only explicit-Flare current-default arms from immutable 4.7.2 Lantern capacity output bb19c9c3e41c08312cff6eb8bd9a62d8ca2fa88ed187e66a4d47af877b371a7c after its omitted-versus-Flare identity proof.

capacityEvidenceBoundary.precondition: A separate capacity protocol must freeze exact row selection, event parser, robust-policy gates, two-sided Scoreline and Afterimage anchors, carrier breadth, viability, reliability, wall time and all decision rules before opening the eligible cache.

decisionRules.success: The four-cell topology is source-exhaustive with exactly one unclosed relation; all source, content, evidence and ledger identities pass without reading trace or cache support and execution finishes within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only multiple-events-multiple-targets for one separately preregistered zero-new-row capacity screen against the eligible 4.7.2 explicit-Flare cache. Do not open the cache before its complete gates are frozen, inspect Beacon, implement a payoff, add a carrier, simulate, add a ledger row, use a method or protected seed.
decisionRules.futility: No unique unclosed per-card Shatter topology remains.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and close this Shatter card-topology frontier. Continue inside issue #421 only from another source-complete structural representation; do not change event cardinality, select a card subset or add a payoff.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any partition, source, evidence, content or ledger identity fails, more than one topology is unclosed, or execution exceeds 30 seconds.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the topology audit inconclusive at cap without reading support, selecting a representation, implementing, simulating, adding a row, using a method or protected seed.
